goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann Anlageentscheidungen anhand ausgewählter Kriterien reflektieren und dabei Geldwertstabilität sowie zentrale Funktionen des Geldes einbeziehen.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: A person considers risk, availability and purchasing power as open criteria, and a coin-to-future-groceries question distinguishes nominal money from possible real purchasing power. No specific asset or return guarantee is given. The private criteria notebook, however, is upright toward the audience and upside down from its seated owner's position.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px the three criteria labels and future purchasing-power question remain recognisable; no miniature investment numbers are needed.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px criteria jars have no selected traffic-light value and do not recommend an asset. The notebook text direction remains plainly audience-facing.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: The personal notebook lies in front of the person with its written top toward her and baseline toward the audience; from the user's position it reads upside down. This violates the actor-perspective requirement.
actualInspection.style: Friendly clear comic raster, coherent broad colors and approachable people without photorealism or sterile technical restyling.

blockingFindings.description: The criteria notebook's text faces the audience rather than its owner.
blockingFindings.targetedCorrection: Rotate only the notebook writing to the owner's reading direction or use a simple text-free criteria structure; keep the open criteria and purchasing-power motif.

interpretationLimits: The containers present reflection criteria rather than named investment recommendations. Unmarked coloured points supply no measured risk ranking or guaranteed future value.
